## about

::: {.body}
I hold a bachelor's degree in International Relations and am a master's student
at the [Federal University of Santa Catarina](https://ufsc.br) (UFSC), in the
[Graduate Program in International Relations](https://ppgri.ufsc.br) (PPGRI),
supervised by Fábio Pádua dos Santos. My dissertation studies China's
technological rise and its position in the hierarchy of the world-economy,
using patent series and economic complexity indicators.

I have been a research assistant at [Labtrans/UFSC](https://labtrans.ufsc.br),
[GEPPIC/UFSC](https://geppic.ufsc.br) and [INCT-INEU](https://ineu.org.br), a
teaching assistant in Political Economy I for the
[Economics undergraduate program at UFSC](https://economia.ufsc.br), and an
exchange student at [Beijing Normal University](https://english.bnu.edu.cn).
:::
